lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical column of four high-intensity circular spots is located posterior to the fifth gill slit. A second, more posterior column contains four equidistant spots, forming a roughly rectangular grid pattern in the lateral mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Spots are precisely centered at the intersection of faint, elevated-luminance vertical bands and the longitudinal axis of the flank, creating a consistent grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous horizontal feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral transition, showing a sharp pixel intensity gradient from high (dorsal) to low (ventral) representing a structural ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive presence of secondary biological entities (remoras) clustered around the pectoral fin and the ventral portion of the head.
